description: Implementation of the TransactionService interface, providing functionality for creating and retrieving transactions related to orders, including parsing transaction details and selecting capturable or refundable transactions.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation managing transactions, including creation, listing, and fetching specific transaction states (capturable, refundable).

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction; serializes transaction details to JSON and stores it.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves list of transactions for an order, parses JSON details into a map for each transaction.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Finds a transaction ready for capture based on transaction types associated with an order.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Determines the most recent refundable transaction for an order, considering various transaction types.
